{{Quote|Mother Calrissian, what has your favorite son got himself into this time?!|Lando Calrissian|<ref name="The Bounty Hunters: Scoundrel's Wages" />}}
"'''Mother Calrissian'''",<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> also known as "'''Mom'''",<ref name="SW1977 52" /> was one of the parents of [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. In his adulthood, Calrissian recalled that she had the ability to remember hundreds of songs and poems. He also recalled her advice: "''Never stand when you can sit down, and never sit when you can lie down''," when [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] found Calrissian in his office, sitting in his own chair.<ref name="BTS" /> She also told her son that [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] didn't pay,<ref name="SW1977 52"/> and that gambling would be the end of him.<ref name="Idiot's Array">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/fiction/f20080522/index.html|text="Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array"|int=Lando Calrissian: Idiot's Array|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>
